summary: Iteration 13 verification of ARIA Daily Call Plan feature. 13/13 backend pytests passed (config defaults + roundtrip, validation 422s, preview HTML, send-now error path, regression on call-priority + best-time-to-call, background loop log). Frontend Settings panel renders all 7 required testids below Calendly Integration in the ARIA Agent tab; tz dropdown includes 5.5 IST; toggle flips Active/Disabled; save persists across reload (verified email=admin@demo.com, hour=9, tz=5.5, size=7); send-now triggers /api/aria/daily-call-plan/send-now → 500 with Resend free-tier error message surfaced via alert (expected upstream limitation).

minor.issue: When the configured send_to_email is null/missing, the endpoint silently falls back to current_user.email instead of returning the documented 400. To force a 400, the test had to rely on user email also being unset (not reachable for admin user). Consider an explicit setting like 'use_logged_in_user_email' or remove the fallback so the 400 path is testable when send_to_email is intentionally cleared.

The default-config branch (when no doc exists) returns timezone_offset_hours=5.5 hard-coded. Spec example shows default 0. Not a bug per se (5.5 is a sensible IST default for the test admin), but inconsistent with the docstring/PRD default of 0. Document or unify.

On Resend failure, _send_daily_call_plan returns {sent:false, error:...} and the endpoint wraps as 500. Confirmed last_sent_date is NOT written on failure (good — idempotency record only on success). However the error string (Resend reply) is leaked verbatim to the client; consider redacting or mapping to a friendlier message in production.

design_issues.screen: Settings → ARIA Agent → Daily Call Plan panel
issues: React hydration warning logged: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. One of the dcp-size-input / dcp-hour-input / dcp-tz-input <select> elements has a <span> nested inside an <option>. HTML spec disallows this; fix by moving any styling/badge inside <option> to plain text or use a custom dropdown component.
Card uses dark theme above (ARIA Control Panel + Calendly with bg-black) but the Daily Call Plan card is white (bg-white). Visual inconsistency within the same tab — consider matching themes.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:3917 — daily_call_plan_collection uses scope='workspace' single-doc upsert. Single-tenant assumption is fine for current MVP; document this limitation when multi-workspace lands.

server.py:4099 — int(send_hour_utc) compared to now_utc.hour; this is correct for whole hours but fractional offsets like 5.5 mean send_hour_utc could be e.g. 2.5 → int()=2. If founder picks send_hour_local=8 with tz=+5.5, send_hour_utc=2.5 and the loop will fire when UTC hour==2, i.e. 7:30am IST, NOT 8:00. Acceptable trade-off but document it (or floor/round consistently).
server.py:4115 — @app.on_event('startup') is deprecated in newer FastAPI in favor of lifespan handlers. Functional today, but may need migration.
server.py:4031 — _send_daily_call_plan catches all Exception and prints; fine for now but consider structured logging.
